comments.text: Level 5's object types, 162 of them, five tables indexed by type (objects_init_new reads them when an object appears). This one: each type's first sprite frame, where its animation starts. Types 5 and 6 are the munitions pods before they are shot (an object below state 7 is a pod), 7 on the enemies; the level's waves and bosses use 60 types, from 5 to 70.
Each object type's last sprite frame, where its animation turns back.
Inside the last-frame table (type 94 on). The front end clears $0200-$03FF before each load, before the level arrives here.
Inside the last-frame table. During a load the KERNAL's IRQ vector is here ($0314), pointed at the game's RTI; the level then overwrites it.
The KERNAL IRQ vector's high byte during a load; level data once loaded.
The KERNAL's NMI vector during a load ($0318), pointed at the front end's RTI; level data once loaded.
The KERNAL NMI vector's high byte during a load; level data once loaded.
Each object type's firing mode (bits 0-1: 2 fires at once, the others when level with the ship), frame delay (bits 2-5) and ping-pong animation (bit 6).
Each object type's colour (low nibble) and group (high nibble): an enemy with a group takes the whole group with it when shot, for 5,000 points.
The colours and groups of types 26-161.
Each object type's hit points, the shots it takes before it bursts.
Two unused bytes between the object types and the paths.
